items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via StyleSmuggler
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. It has been actively exploited in the wild, prompting an emergency hotfix.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these specific issues.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (August 2026)
items.summary: This update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, an incorrect authorization flaw that could lead to unauthenticated customer account takeover and privilege escalation. Active exploitation attempts for CVE-2026-71362 have been observed.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.
